verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev exposes a management API (runs.list, trigger, cancel/retry) and a live auth-gated REST API (docs-3, docs-19, probe-rt-4), plus a CLI and MCP server for programmatic control (docs-16, probe-rt-2, probe-rt-3), covering most core task/run operations achievable via API. However, some UI-only features like the dashboard's Limits/Concurrency purchase page and run-list column customization (docs-9, docs-21, docs-1) have no documented API equivalent, and there's no published OpenAPI spec (probe-3) confirming full API parity. missing for 10: OpenAPI/full API reference confirming parity, API equivalents for dashboard-only billing/concurrency purchase and UI column customization, independent confirmation that all UI actions are API-exposed.
